title: Tensor inheritance of the single-complex base-change condition
statement: For a cartesian square of schemes X' \xrightarrow{g'} X and S' \xrightarrow{g} S, with f:X\to S and f':X'\to S' the vertical morphisms [def-pc-base-change], let K \in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] and let L(g')^*K \to K' be a map in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'}). For x'\in X', put x=g'(x'), s'=f'(x') and s=f(x)=g(s'). If for every x' and i\in\mathbf Z the canonical map H^i(K_x\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'})\otimes_{\mathcal O_{X,x}\otimes_{\mathcal O_{S,s}}\mathcal O_{S',s'}}\mathcal O_{X',x'}\to H^i(K'_{x'}) is an isomorphism, then for every E \in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X), the induced map L(g')^*(E \otimes^L K) \to L(g')^*E \otimes^L K' has the same property: its corresponding canonical map at every x' and i is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Fix x' and write R = O_{S,s}, A = O_{X,x}, B = O_{S',s'}, and C = O_{X',x'}. The stalk of the map for E tensor^L K is obtained by first forming E_x tensor_A^L K_x, then tensoring over R with B and extending scalars to C.

source.place: Tag 0DJA, proof of part (1), local stalk computation

proof.text: Apply [lem-pc-derived-tensor-transitivity] with $T=A\otimes_R B$, $E=E_x$, $K=K_x$ (complexes of $A$-modules), $K'=K'_{x'}$ (a complex of $C$-modules) and $\psi:K_x\otimes_A^{L}C=(L(g')^*K)_{x'}\to K'_{x'}$ the stalk at $x'$ of the given map $L(g')^*K\to K'$ (a morphism in $D(C)$). Then $\varphi_{K_x}=\psi\circ c_{K_x}:K_x\otimes_R^{L}B\to K'_{x'}$ is the stalk map of the hypothesis, and $\beta^i_{K_x}:H^i(K_x\otimes_R^{L}B)\otimes_T C\to H^i(K'_{x'})$ is exactly the canonical map of the hypothesis, which is an isomorphism for every $i$. For $E\otimes^{L}K$, the stalk at $x'$ of $L(g')^*(E\otimes^{L}K)\to L(g')^*E\otimes^{L}K'$ is, under $(E\otimes^{L}K)_x=E_x\otimes_A^{L}K_x$, $(L(g')^*(E\otimes^L K))_{x'}=(E_x\otimes_A^{L}K_x)\otimes_A^{L}C$ and $(L(g')^*E\otimes^{L}K')_{x'}=(E_x\otimes_A^{L}C)\otimes_C^{L}K'_{x'}\cong E_x\otimes_A^{L}K'_{x'}$, the composite of the associativity isomorphism $(E_x\otimes_A^{L}K_x)\otimes_A^{L}C\cong E_x\otimes_A^{L}(K_x\otimes_A^{L}C)$ and $1_{E_x}\otimes\psi$; so its comparison map from $(E_x\otimes_A^{L}K_x)\otimes_R^{L}B$ is $\varphi_{E_x,K_x}$ of the lemma, and the canonical map of the conclusion at $(x',i)$ is $\beta^i_{E_x,K_x}:H^i((E_x\otimes_A^{L}K_x)\otimes_R^{L}B)\otimes_T C\to H^i(E_x\otimes_A^{L}K'_{x'})$. Since $C=\mathcal O_{X',x'}$ is a localization of $T$ (stalk of $X'=X\times_S S'$), it is flat over $T$ (Tag 00HT), so the flat clause of the lemma shows that $\beta^i_{E_x,K_x}$ is an isomorphism for every $i$. Since $x'$ and $i$ were arbitrary, the inherited stalkwise condition holds everywhere.
